name: PT Gaya Abadi Sempurna Tbk
summary: PT Gaya Abadi Sempurna Tbk trades in electronic components and electric bicycles in Indonesia and Singapore. The company operates through Electronic Component; and Electric Bicycle segments. It manufactures and sells e-mopeds, e-bikes, e-motors, personal mobility devices, special purpose vehicles, and Sepeda Angin folding bikes under the JUARA and SELIS brand names; and offers fans and light products. It is also involved in industry, trade, and workshop services. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Tangerang, Indonesia. PT Gaya Abadi Sempurna Tbk is a subsidiary of Pt Selis Investama Indonesia.
